name: proof-tree-companion
description: Editor-side commands for the proof-tree infoview widget: opens a tactic in the lens (a slim editor group split below the infoview) and reveals tree nodes in it, relayed through a request file the widget's Lean RPC writes (the infoview's EditorApi has no executeCommand). Will also grow global settings / persistent state for the widget.

commands.title: Proof Tree: Open Tactic in Lens

proofTree.lensFontScale.markdownDescription: Scale applied to `#editor.fontSize#` while the lens is open, so more of the proof fits its few lines. **This is unavoidably global** — VS Code has no per-editor font API (`TextEditorOptions` covers only tab size, indent, cursor style and line numbers), so the main editor shrinks with it. The original size is restored when the lens closes. Set to `1` to leave your font alone; height and sticky-scroll removal still apply.

proofTree.lensShrinkNudges.markdownDescription: How far to shrink the lens below the 50% split it opens at. The split is roughly 8-9 nudges tall, so **lower is taller** — `0` leaves the lens at half the infoview column.
